comment: Feed categories. A category owns four published files (ipv4, ipv6, ipv4-cidrs, ipv6-cidrs) under feeds/<id>/. status: active = sources wired, planned = published empty until sources are added. Adding a category = one entry here + sources referencing it in sources.json.

categories.name: Botnets
categories.description: IP addresses of infected hosts and bot agents participating in botnet activity.

categories.name: Malware Distribution
categories.description: IPs hosting or serving malware payloads.

categories.name: C2 Infrastructure
categories.description: Botnet and malware command & control servers.

categories.name: DDoS Attack Sources
categories.description: IPs observed participating in DDoS attacks.

categories.name: Open HTTP Proxies
categories.description: Open HTTP/HTTPS proxy servers frequently abused for anonymized attacks.

categories.name: SOCKS4 Proxies
categories.description: Open SOCKS4 proxy servers.

categories.name: SOCKS5 Proxies
categories.description: Open SOCKS5 proxy servers.

categories.name: VPN Endpoints
categories.description: Public VPN exit endpoints.

categories.name: Tor Exit Nodes
categories.description: Tor network exit relays.

categories.name: Public Scanners
categories.description: Internet-wide scanners, probes, and top attacking hosts.

categories.name: Abuse Sources
categories.description: Generic abusers: compromised hosts, attackers, and persistently reported IPs.

categories.name: Spam Sources
categories.description: Forum, blog, and web-form spam sources.

categories.name: Brute Force Sources
categories.description: IPs performing brute-force authentication attacks across services.

categories.name: SSH Attackers
categories.description: IPs attacking SSH services (password guessing, scanning).

categories.name: RDP Attackers
categories.description: IPs attacking RDP services.

categories.name: Credential Stuffing Sources
categories.description: IPs performing web login brute-force / credential stuffing.

categories.name: Web Exploit Scanners
categories.description: IPs scanning for or exploiting web application vulnerabilities.

categories.name: Known Exploited Infrastructure
categories.description: Confirmed compromised machines and exploited infrastructure.

categories.name: High Risk Networks
categories.description: Hijacked or criminal-controlled netblocks (e.g. Spamhaus DROP).

categories.name: Residential Proxies
categories.description: Residential proxy exit nodes.

categories.name: Hosting Provider Networks
categories.description: Hosting/cloud provider ranges (optional category for scoring, not blocking).

categories.name: Honeypot Hits
categories.description: IPs observed hitting OpenShield honeypots.

categories.name: Community Reports
categories.description: Community-submitted reputation reports (future).
